objectives: Use diagnostic evidence to select a specific ng skill for practice.
Re-teach the weakest component with guided examples.
Demonstrate transfer on 15 fresh reassessment items.
Advance at 80% or continue targeted practice if below threshold.
concepts: Remediation should match the diagnosed need.
Sound recognition errors need listening contrasts; decoding errors need guided blending.
Reassessment must use fresh items to measure transfer.
Mastery routing should be consistent and transparent.

definitions.definition: Focused teaching and practice for a diagnosed learning need.
A new assessment after targeted instruction.
A fresh example that tests whether a skill generalises.

workedExamples.solution: Practise sing/sin and ring/rim listening contrasts.
Focus on decoding and checking the final ng digraph.
Segment the word and map ng as one grapheme.

commonMistakes: Repeating every lesson instead of targeting the weak component.
Using speed alone as evidence of fluency.
keyTakeaways: Select the component from diagnostic evidence.
Model, practise with feedback, then use fresh items.
At or above 80% advance; below 80% continue targeted support.
